Issue details

Remote Desktop Services might become unstable

Status: Mitigated · Originating update: OS Build 26100.33438 KB5999011 2026-09-08 · History: Last updated: 2026-09-12, 14:20 PT Opened: 2026-09-10, 09:12 PT

After installing the September 2026 Windows security update (KB5999011), some organizations might experience issues with Remote Desktop Services (RDS) on Windows Server 2025 session hosts.

Workaround: Apply the Known Issue Rollback (KIR) Group Policy for Windows Server 2025.

Affected platforms:

  • Server: Windows Server 2025
